Pricing.title: Pricing
Pricing.description: Compare AlphaBes Free and Pro plans. Pro is $7.99/month or $59/year.
Pricing.heading: Plans and Pricing
Pricing.subtitle: Start free. Upgrade any time.
Pricing.intro: The free plan includes every printable worksheet, the alphabet and phonics lessons, the free games, and progress tracking for each child. Pro adds the premium games and one-click downloads of whole worksheet bundles, for parents and teachers who want everything.
Pricing.billingNote: Paid securely through PayPal. Pro renews automatically; cancel any time from your dashboard and keep Pro until the end of the period you've paid for.
